# Treat the first Account Hub split as a staged framework change

573 explicitly says the patch does not go past the first step and performs no background work. Full diffs show it removes the former field-driven controller, replaces it with a state table and leaves findConfig and later actions unfinished. It is not simply moving working code into files. Preserve the historical readiness boundary when explaining project direction. Current accepted source performs awaited discovery and handles missing configurations and credential redirects; those later implementations were compared only in focused sections.

Scope: Account Hub rollout architecture.
